name: Contentious Plan
oracle_text:
Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)
Draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

needs.what: a proliferate op that lets the controller choose any number of permanents (any controller) and/or players that have counters, then adds one more counter of each kind already on each chosen object or player (including player counters such as poison/energy/experience)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The existing proliferate op is a simplification: it makes no choice and never touches players or opponents' permanents, so it does not implement rule 701.27
